title: Marketplace usage & pricing matrix + UX copy (draft)
body:
Objective:
- Draft a concise pricing and usage matrix for cloud marketplace listings plus suggested UI microcopy for each purchase step. This is a working doc to align GTM, finance, and product on what we show in the marketplace tile, the purchase flow, and the SKU/billing mapping.

Audience:
- Cloud marketplace reviewer, partner ops, finance pricing reviewer, and the partner engineering lead who wires billing/SaaS integration.

High-level positioning (one-liner for market tile):
- "Redwood Inference — predictable, low-latency LLM inference with enterprise-grade controls and flexible billing."
  - Alternative short variants (A/B test ideas):
    - "High-throughput LLM inference with predictable costs and private deployment options."
    - "Scale LLM inference: dedicated capacity, burstable usage, and usage-based billing."

Key messages to surface on tile and details page (order of priority):
1) What you get: hosted inference endpoints, dedicated reserved capacity, private deployment options.
2) Cost model: pay-as-you-go tokens + optional reserved commit discounts.
3) Compliance & controls: VPC, KMS, audit logs, enterprise SLA.
4) Quickstart: 5-min API key, sample app, Terraform module link.

Pricing & usage matrix (draft - to be validated with finance):
- Pricing constructs: Token-based active inference (per-1k tokens), embedding unit (per-embedding), Reserved GPU commit (monthly SKU), and Overcommit burst surcharge.

- Proposed SKU names + public-facing pricing labels (copy-ready):
  1) "Inference (per 1k tokens)" — usage meter, billed monthly.
     - Example price band (public): $0.003 / 1k tokens (hosted; base model family).
     - Notes: different model families have multiplier e.g., +2x for larger models, +0.8x for quantized variants.
  2) "Embeddings (per 1k vectors)" — usage meter for embedding calls.
     - Example price: $0.02 / 1k vectors.
  3) "Reserved Capacity (monthly)" — commit SKU for Dedicated pools.
     - Example tiers: small / medium / large with throughput guarantees.
  4) "Burst Overage" — surcharge per token when a reserved pool is exceeded.
     - Example: +25% on standard per-token rate.

- Billing mapping guidance for marketplace:
  - Marketplace usage meter should map to our backend meters: token_count, embedding_count, reserved_capacity_commit.
  - For marketplaces that only support monthly seat-like SKUs, present a "Dedicated Starter" SKU mapped to a minimum monthly commit and reconcile metered usage off-platform.

UX flow sketch (purchase -> provision -> first call) with microcopy suggestions:
1) Marketplace tile -> Click "Get" or "Subscribe"
   - Tile subtitle: "Start with a free trial — 10M tokens, no credit card required."
2) Checkout modal -> Plan selection + optional reserved tier
   - Microcopy: "Choose pay-as-you-go or reserve capacity for predictable throughput and lower per-token costs."
   - Toggle caption: "Reserve capacity (recommended for production)"
3) Consent & contract step (if required by marketplace)
   - Microcopy: "By subscribing you accept Redwood's terms. Enterprise contracts will follow via your account rep."
4) Provisioning status screen
   - Message: "Setting up your account and provisioning endpoints. This typically completes within 3–10 minutes."
   - CTA: "Open dashboard" + one-line note: "Need private deployment? Talk to sales."
5) First-call success banner
   - Message: "You're live — try a sample request to validate latency. See token usage and cost in Console > Billing."

Acceptance checklist for marketplace submission (technical + docs):
- Listing assets: 1x short tile description (<=110 chars), 1x long description (500–800 chars), 3 screenshots (Console billing, model selector, latency dashboard), 1 logo (SVG/PNG).
- Quickstart: 1-click sample app + cURL snippet + Terraform module link.
- Security checklist: SOC/ISO statements, KMS support note, network controls (VPC), data handling statement.
- Billing artifacts: SKU mapping table, example invoice line items, reconciliation doc for reserved commits.
- Legal: templates for marketplace T&Cs plus contact for enterprise contract escalation.
- Integration hooks: webhook endpoint for marketplace metering callbacks, monitoring endpoint, and sample reconciliation script (python).

Copy examples for key UI elements (concise, test-ready):
- Tile subtitle: "Predictable LLM inference — hosted, dedicated, or private."
- Short benefit blurb (50 chars): "Low-latency inference with usage-based billing."
- CTA (tile): "Try free" / "Subscribe" (A/B with free trial emphasis)
- Plan card header for reserved: "Dedicated capacity — guaranteed throughput"
- Billing tooltip text: "Monthly invoice lists metered tokens, embedding calls, and any reserved commit charges."

Edge cases and marketplace limitations to handle (engineering notes):
- Some marketplaces do not support metered per-token billing natively. Plan: publish a single monthly SKU that includes a usage allowance and reconcile usage off-platform through our billing integration.
- Marketplace rate limits / provisioning delays — include retry and fallback copy for customers who hit provisioning window > 15 minutes.
- Model family substitution: if a marketplace variant cannot surface many model SKUs, use a generic "Standard" vs "High-capacity" label and handle exact model mapping in the Console.

Open questions (to resolve before submission):
- Final public per-1k token price bands (input from Finance) — tag finance owner.
- Free trial size and gating policy (fraud prevention) — security + ops to sign off.
- Mapping of "reserved tiers" to actual GPU types and regional availability — infra to confirm.

Next steps + tentative owners:
- Finalize price bands and SKU IDs (Finance: Ravi Patel) — due: 2025-09-19.
- Prepare screenshots and short demo script (GTM/Marketing: Marta Alvarez) — due: 2025-09-22.
- Engineering to provide metering callback spec and reconciliation script (ENG: Jonah Ruiz) — due: 2025-09-26.
- Legal to provide marketplace contract addendum (Legal: Leah Morgan) — due: 2025-09-24.

Notes / rough ideas (scratchpad):
- Consider offering an "embedded credits" promo for partners that list us in their solution gallery (promo SKU).
- UX experiment: label pay-as-you-go plan with estimated monthly spend examples based on typical workloads (e.g., chat bot X requests/day).
- Keep the tile copy short and rely on details page for pricing breakdowns; marketplaces favor short titles.

References & links:
- Internal pricing model doc: https://confluence.redwood.local/display/PRICE/Token-Pricing-Model
- Sandbox quickstart repo: github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-quickstart

Inbox notes (things to follow up in next sync):
- Sync with finance on whether to publish differential pricing for quantized models in the marketplace or collapse to a single headline price.
- Validate the free trial entitlement size with SRE to ensure capacity not unexpectedly consumed by trials.

-- end of draft --

(This doc is intentionally lightweight — use as source for the marketplace listing form and the product-page copy pack. Flag any marketplace-specific gating items you see and drop them below.)
